notes.title: Lost in Play & Boxes: Lost Fragments Bundle
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Lost in Play & Boxes: Lost Fragments are now available as a bundle! 

Lost in Play is a quirky 2D hand-drawn puzzle adventure about two siblings lost in their imagination. They need to solve puzzles, befriend magical creatures, and stick together in a wacky imaginary world to find their way home. 

Boxes: Lost Fragments and Lost in Play are like two ends of the puzzle genre spectrum, and now you can get the best of both worlds at a better price! 🏷️

 🔗Join us on Discord to become a part of our community! 

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/38588/Lost_in_Play__Boxes_Lost_Fragments/

notes.title: Boxes content update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We've been reading your feedback and have implemented a substantial update for Boxes. 

We replaced several of the puzzles with more original, more diverse, and a bit harder ones. Additionally, we adjusted the clarity and difficulty of some of the puzzles, based on feedback and statistics. 

We also changed the ending of the game, and we added a Story Notes menu, where you can read all of the unlocked story cards. Finally, we fixed several bugs and polished the art a bit.

Happy gaming and thank you for your ongoing support!

Enjoy!

notes.title: Boxes: Lost Fragments is out now!

notes.title: Final Release Date
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

After more than 2 years of hard work, we are delighted to share that the official release date for Boxes: Lost Fragments is the 1st of February!

To make sure we deliver a stable game, we will be running a week-long beta test, set to kick off in the coming days. If you want to help with testing the game, please join us on Discord via this link: https://discord.gg/xmWu7Px59n


Also, we will update the demo with completely new content, that includes part of the story and parts of the first-person gameplay.

Thank you!

notes.title: Boxes: Lost Fragments Progress Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

We want to thank you for your unwavering patience and support! The last 2 months have been a flurry of non-stop effort as we dedicated ourselves to finishing the game.

Boxes is now in its final form, having undergone several rigorous rounds of internal testing and refinements. However, before we can release it, we still need to test with more players for stability and clarity of the gaming experience. 

That’s why we want to invite you to participate in our upcoming closed beta test, scheduled for next week. If you want to play the game earlier and help us test it, please join the Boxes beta-testers channel in our Discord server at https://discord.gg/9yMajRxPSD and stay tuned for further instructions.

Our new target release date is January 25, depending on the successful outcome of the beta test.

Thank you for being part of this exciting journey!

notes.title: Boxes: Lost Fragments Release Date Update
notes.content:
First, we would like to say a huge ‘Thank you!’ to everyone who follows the game and can’t wait to play it!

The main reason for the delays is that we decided to make the game bigger and better. 

We added first-person puzzle escape gameplay before, between, and after all diorama box levels. This additional gameplay adds variety to our diorama puzzle boxes, making the game more diverse.

Also, it allowed us to tell the story in a much better way, with more cutscenes and a tangible location for where the action happens. We think that the two game modes complement each other quite well. Check out a short teaser of the new functionality here:

[previewyoutube=HbaXQb1CpuM;full][/previewyoutube]

That being said, our new target release date is January 11th, 2024.

We expect the game to be ready at the end of November, and we are considering a closed beta test with real players in December. This way the most eager of you can play the full game earlier and for free, and help us with testing the stability.

Thank you, and stay tuned!
